caveat: Main progression bosses only (event bosses such as Dark Mage, Ogre, Betsy, Pumpking and the Lunar pillars, and the Mechdusa seed boss, are omitted). Hardmode page leaves most boss gear unlocks as not stated (n/s), so gear is mostly given by ore/bar tier below. Order follows the Bosses page. Lunatic Cultist timing: Bosses page says after Golem and Skeletron; Hardmode page says tied to Golem. Read via summarising fetch; spot-check.
altar_rounds: Wall of Flesh guarantees a Pwnhammer, which breaks Demon/Crimson Altars. The first three altar rounds set the Hardmode ore pairs (Cobalt/Palladium, then Mythril/Orichalcum, then Adamantite/Titanium).
